question_text: Write a paragraph about "Your School Magazine". [DjB '20; MB '24]

answer_text:
Drug Addiction (মাদকাসক্তি)
Drug addiction means strong attraction for taking harmful drugs. Drug addiction has now become a serious problem of our society, especially in the town areas. Many young men and women are falling victims to this. It is a curse which ruins them completely. People become addicted to drugs for many reasons. Frustration is one of them. Unemployment problem, political unrest, lack of love and affection, family problem, etc. lead a man to frustration. Young generations mainly become victim to it. It leads a man to death. Drug addiction destroys us morally, physically and financially. For this reason, a drug addict cannot lead a normal life. As young generations are the future of the country, they should be aware of the harm of drugs. Besides we cannot allow this to go on unchecked. We must fight against this social cancer. The first thing to do is to highlight its dangerous effect to the people and make them aware of this deadly enemy of social life. The mass media can play an effective (কার্যকর) role in this respect. Seminars and discussions and debate should be held in schools, colleges and universities. The government alone cannot solve this problem single handed. People must co-operate with it.
question_text: Write a paragraph on "Drug Addiction". [CB '20]

answer_text:
A School Library (একটি বিদ্যালয় গ্রন্থাগার)
A school library is a place where collections of books are kept for the students to read or borrow. A school library is an important part of a school. Renowned schools have a separate building for the library. Generally a library is situated on the top floor of the school building. It is large and spacious. There are a number of bookshelves, chairs, and broad tables. There are separate shelves for books on separate subjects like history, geography, Bangla and English literature, Philosophy, Economics, Science, Religion etc. Books are arranged on the shelves according to the catalog. There is a librarian who helps the students find out books according to their need. Students go to the library to read and learn details about any subject. They can collect books from the library to take home and keep with them for a certain period. The library should have a very silent, neat and clean and congenial atmosphere to read attentively. At a corner of the library there are daily newspapers, national and international journals. Thus it helps the students to grow up intellectually.
question_text: Write a paragraph on "A School Library". [DB '22; CtgB '19]

answer_text:
My Visit to A Place of Historical Interest
(একটি ঐতিহাসিকভাবে বিখ্যাত স্থান ভ্রমণ).[ Shat Gambuz Mosque ]
I visited the Shat Gambuz Mosque during the last Ramadan vacation. To visit the mosque I accompanied by one of my bosom friends went to Bagerhat. We stayed there for five hours and gathered a lot of experience by visiting the mosque. It is a place of historical interest in Bangladesh. We got much historical information of the famous mosque. The mosque has its glorious (মহান) historical precedents. In the mid 15th century, a Muslim Colony was founded in the inhospitable mangrove forest of the Sundarbans near the sea coast of Bagerhat district by a saint Ulugh Khan Jahan. He was the earliest torch bearer of Islam. The mosque impressed (মুগ্ধ করা) me very much. The stately fabric of the monument stands by a water tank. The mosque is roofed over with 77 squat domes including 7 chauchala or four sided domes in the middle row. The vast prayer hall is provided with 11 arched door ways. The architecture (স্থাপত্যশিল্প) of the mosque is attractive. The tank near the mosque is nice to look at. Its opaque water is sacred to all irrespective of caste or creed. Now it is one of the greatest tourist attractions.
question_text: Write a paragraph on "Your Visit to a Place of Historical Interest". [DB '17; CtgB '05; SB '07]

answer_text:
A Railway Station (একটি রেলস্টেশন)
A railway station is a place where trains stop for the passengers to get into and get down from them. It becomes very busy because of the arrival of trains. Here passengers are found to stand in a queue to collect their tickets in front of the ticket counters. A big station is always crowded with passengers, hawkers, and porters. There are tea stalls, book-sellers and waiting rooms in such stations. Vendors shout their trade cries. When a train reaches the station, the passengers hurry to get off from the train. At the same time passengers waiting for the train want to get into the train. As a result, a huddling situation of two groups of passengers takes place. When the train leaves the station, it becomes deserted and buzzing sound of the passengers ends. A railway station is often used as a den for the anti-social elements. It is a suitable place for the beggars to carry on their trade. It is an unhygienic (অস্বাস্থ্যকর) place too. But it plays a great role in communication system of a country. The authorities (কর্তৃপক্ষ) should look into it.
question_text: Write a paragraph on "A Railway Station". [RB '12; DjB '17]

answer_text:
Air Pollution (বায়ুদূষণ)
Air is a life giving force. Both, animals and plants inhale oxygen or carbon-dioxide from the air. So, if the air is polluted, naturally it makes a great threat to all. That's why air is an important element of our environment. But air is being polluted so severely that this problem has become a global concern at present. Air is polluted in many ways. But air pollution is more acute in urban areas because vehicles and mills and factories here emit carbon monoxide gases and smokes that pollute our city air seriously. Besides, burning of trash and indiscriminate discharge of human waste in the open air are also the cause of serious air pollution. Vehicles that emit excessive smoke should be banned. Lead-free petrol should be used and compressed air should be used in vehicles to minimise air pollution because the WHO and the UNO's environmental section indicate Dhaka as the most polluted city in the world. By inhaling polluted air we are falling victim of bronchitis and other respiratory diseases. The best way to stop air pollution is to plant trees and take care of them. The wildlife must be preserved and the mass cutting down of trees must be prevented.
question_text: Write a paragraph on "Air Pollution". [DB '16]

answer_text:
A Village Doctor (একজন গ্রাম্য ডাক্তার)
A village doctor is a familiar (পরিচিত) figure to the villagers. His knowledge of medicine is very little. He only undergoes a few months' training under non-govt. LMF training center or under a medical practitioner. Then he starts his independent (স্বাধীন) practice. A village doctor is called a quack (হাতুড়ে ডাক্তার). In his dispensary he gives advice and prescribes medicine for the patients (রোগী). He has an assistant in his dispensary. He gives medicine to the patients according to the prescription (ব্যবস্থাপত্র). He has one or two almirahs in his dispensary. He has not a large stock of medicines. He has only cheap and common medicines in his dispensary. After finishing his duty in his dispensary, he goes out to see patients in the village with a medicine bag. This bag looks like a "First-aid" box. He usually goes on foot or a bicycle to visit his patients. In a word he is an important and useful member of the village society.
question_text: Write a paragraph about 'A Village Doctor'. [DB '08]

answer_text:
A Bus-Stand (একটি বাসস্ট্যান্ড)
Commonly a bus-stand is a place where buses stop and start from. Generally, it stands at the outskirts of a town or city. It carries a great value for the passengers of long drive. It is quite a crowded place. In the maximum bus stands there is a waiting room for the passengers. Passengers don't have to wait for long time for the buses. Passengers gather at bus stand to get into the bus when it comes. It is visible that both passengers and coolies are equally busy at the stand. Some passengers wait for buses for a while and go into the tea-stall for drinking a cup of tea. Most of buses cannot come to the station in time because of jam. It is sometimes seen that buses are overcrowded then the environment inside the buses is suffocating (শ্বাসরুদ্ধকর). However, a bus-stand is a temporary shelter for passengers. In some bus stands there are counters for booking ticket. Passengers stand in a line for buying tickets. Sometimes some ill-tempered (বদমেজাজী) passengers break the line and quarrel among themselves. Many kinds of things are found at the bus stand. There are found road-side tea-stalls, other small shops, hawkers selling betel-leaf and cigarette at a bus stand. Magazine and seasonal (মৌসুমী) fruits are available here. Indeed it is a place of crowd.
question_text: Write a paragraph about 'A Bus Stand'. [JB '05; CtgB '08]

answer_text:
May Day (মে দিবস)
May 1st, International Workers Day, is observed as May Day. To commemorate the historic struggle of working people throughout the world the day is observed. From the beginning of the Industrial Revolution people in factories have worked very long shifts lasting up to fourteen or even more hours a day. In the 1880 a new movement (আন্দোলন) calling for an eight hour day inspired (অনুপ্রাণিত করা) both Labour Unions and unorganised (অসংগঠিত) workers. The workers fought for some rights; a minimum wage, safety laws and the guarantee of eight hour workday. To establish these rights they launched a concerted movement against the prevalent (বিরাজমান) law and law enforcing and enacting agencies. As a result on May 3, 1889, police fired into a crowd of strikers at the McComick Harvest Machine Company, Chicago, killing at least one stricker, seriously wounding five or six others and injuring an undetermined number. All these are infeasible to be forgettable and all these have determined better working conditions, better pay and better lives for today's workers and this is the importance of the day. May 1st, is now recognised in most countries of the world.
[185 words]
question_text: Write a paragraph about 'May-Day'. [CtgB '07]

answer_text:
The Person I Like Most/ My Favourite Personality (আমার প্রিয় ব্যক্তিত্ব)
I have met many men in my life. Some of them are great, some mediocre while others are ordinary. Of all men I have met I consider Abdur Rouf to be the most unforgettable character. He is my cousin and senior to me by five years. He is 25 years old and still a student. He is of fair complexion, well-built and tall for his age. He is a man of superb personality (ব্যক্তিত্ব). He helps us in every possible ways. I like him more for his fellow-feeling attitude. He is an example of humanitarian service. He is honest, truthful, straightforward (স্পষ্টবাদী) and outspoken but at the same time he is polite and humble. He points out other men's errors in a most gentle and pleasing way, so that nobody is displeased with him. He is fully aware of those people who have no moral stamina, no spirit of self-abnegation, no love for honesty and integrity. I have never met such a person as Rouf Bhai who possesses qualities like him. For this reason, I like him most.

question_text: Suppose, you are Abir. You have a pen-friend named Zim who lives in Australia. He wants to know about the anti-discrimination student movement in Bangladesh. Now, write a letter to him about it.

22/A West Dhanmondi
Dhaka
11 October 2025
Dear Zim,
I hope you're doing well! I'm excited to tell you about the anti-discrimination student movement in Bangladesh, which has made a huge impact on our society. The movement initially began with students rallying for merit-based opportunities. They wanted to end the unfair quota system, which often limited opportunities for qualified students by reserving a large portion of jobs and university seats for specific groups. As this student-led protest grew, people from all walks of life began to join, seeing it as a stand against systemic discrimination and inequality. Over time, the movement evolved from focusing solely on quota reforms to challenging the government's authoritarian actions. The protests became a call for a more democratic and fair system, with the movement finally demanding that the fascist government step down. In the end, it wasn't just about students' rights but about justice and equality for all. The unity between students and the general public showed the strength of a united front against discrimination. Let me know if you want to hear more details!
Best wishes,
Abir

question_text: Suppose, you are Anuvob/Anuva. You have a pen friend named Javan who lives in the USA. He wants to know about your country. Now, write a letter to your friend describing your country.
answer_text:
Oxford Mission Road, Barishal
08 March 2025
Dear Jovan,
How do you do, my dear? Ok? I hope so. A few days ago you wrote a letter to me which is yet unanswered for my some technical problems. In your letter you expressed a heart felt and exalted devotion to know about my darling motherland and her people. Now be mindful and pay heed to the following fact. Bangladesh is a South Asian country with a tiny area and a big population. The people here are of various creeds, castes, customs. The riverine country, Bangladesh, is a natural fair of natural goods such as forest land, running rivers, sea beach, hilly areas, stagnant beel, jheel etc. The natural sequences surrounding and embracing our land are a panorama of vision. The Sundarbans and Kuakata sea beach of South Bangla, Cox's Bazar sea beach of south-easternmost zone of Bangladesh, the river basin of the Padma, the Meghna and the Jamuna-all these are the hoarders of pictorial quality of a poet's brush. You can see here acres of meadow or grass land, innumerable fields across the meadow, countless gleaners gleaning in the fields during the harvesting season, juice oozing from the date top during the winter, minstrels or bards wandering about in villages and hamlets in our agro and village based country. Six seasons, prevalent in Bangladesh, are a newer experience for you respectively. Flood often visits my Bangladesh due to her geographical position or stand and climatic condition. In fact, natural disasters perform here like a brutal step mother. Despite manifold natural adversities we are heading as a independent nation towards world standard respecting education, culture, solidarity, state policy and parity between men and communities. Oh yes, the people of our country are extraordinarily amiable. We have laid down our lives for language and liberty of state and idea. You, therefore, cannot blow away our sense of fraternity, solidarity and unity. We are not as white as you in complexion but trying with our level best to be as civilised as you. I am putting an ending mark now and you are ardently expected to be our tropical land during the next dry season.
Your friend,
Anuvob

It seems to me a miracle that you could read my mind and sent me just the book I wanted eagerly. I have got a lot of presents on my birthday, but yours is the best. Father is loud in praise of your choice. In fact, it is a nice dictionary as it contains not only the meanings of the words, but also their different usages which we need to learn English. However, I must say that though your present pleased me very much, I would have been happier if you were yourself present here on the occasion. I missed you very much.
Yours ever,
Samia

question_text: Suppose, you are Himu and live at the hostel of Vidyamayee Govt. Girls' High School, Mymensingh. Your village home is at Narayankhola, Modhupur, Tangail where your parents live. Now, write a letter to your mother telling her about your hostel life.
answer_text:
Room No-105
Vidyamayee School Hostel
10 February 2025
My dear Mother,
Hope, you are safe and sound by the grace of almighty Lord. I am also well by His grace. However, from your last letter I have come to learn that you are eager to know about my hostel life. Now I am writing about it. Our school hostel is a two storey building. It is south facing. So southern breeze enters almost every room. I stay at first floor. My room No. is 105. It is very spacious. By this, we get a golden opportunity of taking physical exercise. Moreover, we take physical exercise regularly getting up early in the morning. We also gossip with each other and pass our leisure amusingly. In a word, our hostel life is full of joy and enjoyment. Don't worry about me. My study is going on well. There are two teachers staying at our school hostel. They are very cooperative. They help us in our studies when needed. In short it's my hostel life. I must finish here. Convey my salam to father and love to Rumi and Rakib.
Your loving daughter,
Himu

question_text: Suppose, you are Rupam/Afsana living at Muradpur, Chattogram. Your friend is Rana/Rina who lives at College Road, Rajshahi. He/She wanted to know how you spent your last summer vacation. Now, write a letter to your friend describing your experiences during the summer vacation.
answer_text:
Muradpur, Chattogram
June 17, 2025
Dear Rana,
How are you? I hope, you are hale and hearty by the mercy of almighty Allah. I am also fine by His grace. From your last letter I have come to learn that you are interested to know how I spent my last summer vacation. Getting summer vacation I actually went to my native village. I caught fish from our pond with my hands. I picked up ripe mangoes from our gardens. I tasted them to my heart's content. I also picked up jackfruits and took them abundantly. I played hide and seek, football, cricket, hadudu with my cousins and got much enjoyment. My grandparents entertained me with special dishes. They took care of me very cordially, In fact, I was heartily amused and amazed in the last summer vacation. If you were with me, I would also be more entertained. No more today. Convey my regards to dear uncle and aunt and love to Rupa.
Yours ever,
Rupam

question_text: Imagine that one of your school friends is in England for six months. He/She is having some troubles with the new place and the new food. Write a letter advising him/her on how to adjust the new place and the new food.
answer_text:
Sutrapur, Dhaka
14 February 2025
Dear 'X',
At the beginning of the letter, take my cordial love. Hope that you are well by the grace (দয়া) of almighty Allah. I am also well by His grace. However, from your last letter I came to know that you are having some troubles with the new place and the new food. Friend, new thing is a new experience. As the new place is unknown to you, try to be known to it. Then you can gather a lot of experience. At first, you can't adjust yourself with the new place. Gradually, you can adjust yourself with the new place and environment. Similarly you can adjust yourself with the new food gradually. That's to say, when you are habituated (অভ্যস্ত) in taking those foods, you can adjust yourself with those very easily. Of course, it will take some time. Have patience (ধৈর্য). Don't be anxious. No more today. Convey (জানানো) my best regards to your parents and my love to your younger sister.
Yours lovingly,
'Y'

question_text: Suppose, you are Sohan/Sohana of 9, Mymensingh Road, Dhaka-1000. Recently you have enjoyed a picnic. Your friend Nahid/Nahida of 71/C, Broad Lane, Khulna wants to know about the picnic. Now, write a letter to your friend telling him/her how you have enjoyed the picnic.
answer_text:
9, Mymensingh Road,
Dhaka-1000
20 March 2025
Dear Nahid,
I received your letter on the 10th instant. I am sorry for not replying to it earlier. In your letter you wanted to know about the picnic that I had made with my friends at a place of historical importance. Here I am giving you a description of the picnic. I along with my friends made a plan to visit Sonargaon. On February 20, we started from Dhaka by bus at 8 a.m. We reached the spot at 10 a.m. We took necessary food and drinks with us. Reaching there at first we took our breakfast and then started to see the ancient places. To memorise the moment I took some photos. As I have the experience about the place I guided my friends to show the relics. We spent the whole day at the site of the picnic and enjoyed ourselves. After sunset we came back to Dhaka by bus. Actually, we spent a happy moment and its impression (ধারণা) will be everlasting on my mind. No more today. Please write to me as early as possible.
With best regards,
Sohan

question_text: Suppose, you are Sayem/Samia. You and your parents went to Chattogram by train a few days ago. You wish to share this new experience with your friend Abrar/Anika. Now, write a letter to your friend sharing the experience of the train journey that you made.
answer_text:
3 Srish Das Lane,
Sutrapur, Dhaka
19 February 2025
Dear Anika,
Your letter of the 18th instant is to hand. I am very glad to know from your letter that you are hale and hearty. Anyway, today I'll share an experience of a thrilling train journey with you that I underwent accompanying my parents few days ago. We went to Chattogram by train to visit my uncle living there. On the appointed day we went to the Kamalapur Railway Station at 7:00 am. The train left the station duely. I sat on my seat. I felt thrilled (রোমাঞ্চিত) and excited when the train sped up and everything seemed to me to be moving and jolting. Not only this, it seemed to me that everything was going on along with the train. It made me much more excited and thrilled. At last, our train reached the destination (গন্তব্য) at 2:00 pm. I hired a porter to carry my luggage and gave him some wages. And that was my first train journey in my life. No more today. More when we shall meet each other. Convey my best regards to your parents and love to the youngers.
Yours ever,
Samia
flag_note: মডেলে 'duely' ছাপা (duly-এর বদলে) — যেমন ছাপা তেমন রাখা হয়েছে।

question_text: Suppose, you are Mollick/Mollicka. You have recently visited a new place with some of your friends and family members. Now, write a letter to your friend Asif/Asifa who lives in another city, describing your experience of the visit.
answer_text:
Shyamnagar, Satkhira
February 2025
My dear Asifa,
Take my heartest (আন্তরিক) love at first. You haven't written to me for about two months. However, this writing is to inform you of a pleasing tour that I along with some of my friends and family members made last week. The tour was to grand city, Dhaka. We enjoyed the place very much. Now I would like to share my feelings and experience with you. You know one of my brothers lives in the city of Dhaka. He had been requesting me to go to Dhaka to visit the city. So last week I decided to go to Dhaka. We went to Dhaka by bus and my brother received me at the Gabtali Bus Terminal. From the next day we started visiting different places in Dhaka city with my brother. He was in fact our guide. He took us to many important places in the city. First of all, we visited the Naitonal Memorial at Savar. Then I was astonished (বিস্মিত হওয়া) visiting the 'Jatya Sangsad Bhaban' because of its architectural beauty and vast compound. In the afternoon we visited National Shaheed Minar and National Museum. The next day we went to the National Zoo at Mirpur, Lalbag Fort and some other places. We also visited newly built flyover at different places in Dhaka. We also visited some historical places in Old Dhaka such as Star Mosque, Ahsan Monjil, Lalbag Fort, Hosni Dalan etc. Visiting these places we not only enjoyed much but also gathered a lot of experience. This tour to Dhaka will remain ever fresh in my mind. No more today. Best regards (শ্রদ্ধা) to your parents and also love to the youngers.
Yours ever,
Mollicka
flag_note: মডেলে 'Naitonal' ছাপা (National-এর বদলে); এছাড়া পৃষ্ঠা ৫৩৫-এর স্ক্যানে বাম কিনারা কাটা থাকায় শিরোনামের স্থান-নাম ('amnagar' অংশটুকু দৃশ্যমান) ও তারিখের দিন পড়া যায়নি — স্থান Shyamnagar ধরে ও দিন ছাড়া 'February 2025' লেখা হয়েছে।

question_text: Suppose, you are Raton/Ratna living at Nutun para, Natore. The annual prize giving ceremony of your school was over. You got a prize for your better result. Now, write a letter to your friend Tasin/Tasnia who lives at Hospital Road, Pabna describing the annual prize-giving ceremony of your school. — interest of your friend. — time and place of the ceremony. — the beginning of the ceremony. — giving prizes. — stage drama.
answer_text:
Nutun Para, Natore
May 2025
My dear Tasnia,
Take my love from the core of my heart. I hope, you are all right. I am also well. You wanted to know about the prize giving ceremony of our school. Now, I am writing to you about it. Last Sunday, 20 May was the annual prize giving ceremony for academic result and sports. The function was very colourful. It was held on our school playground. In order to celebrate the day the authority (কর্তৃপক্ষ) concerned decorated the school premises (প্রাঙ্গণ) with colourful flags and festoons. The function began with the reciting from the holy Quran. The youth and sports minister was invited as the chief guest. I got a prize for better result in the Test Examination. Many students got prizes. flag_note: মডেলের শেষে স্বাক্ষরের নাম ছাপা নেই — 'Yours loving,'-এই চিঠি শেষ; এছাড়া স্ক্যানে বাম কিনারা কাটা থাকায় তারিখের দিন পড়া যায়নি, তাই 'May 2025' লেখা হয়েছে।

question_text: Suppose, you are Arif/Arifa living at 3/A, Tikatuli, Dhaka. Your cousin Sumon/Sumona lives at 13/3, Ibrahimpur, Jashore. Now, write a letter to your cousin requesting him/her for staying a few days with you during the summer vacation.
answer_text:
3/A, Tikatuli, Dhaka
18 March 2025
Dear Sumona,
Your sweet letter has anchored the shore of my heart. I came to know that your school will be closed for the summer vacation from the 25th March. I would like to give you a proposal for spending a few days with us in Dhaka. After a long confinement in the routine life, you will feel happy in Dhaka. If you come, we'll visit many important places in Dhaka. You know there are some historical place in Dhaka such as Ahsan Monjil, Lalbag Fort, Star Mosque, Chotto Katara, Boro Katara and so as. flag_note: মডেলে 'We way gather' ও 'and so as' ছাপা (may / and so on-এর বদলে) — যেমন ছাপা তেমন রাখা হয়েছে।

question_text: Imagine, you are Kaspia/Kaspian of 12, Mirpur Road, Dhaka. One of your friends is very weak in English. Now, write a letter to your friends Rosmin/Rosmina who lives at Patiya, Chattogram, telling him/her about how to improve English. Use the following clues : — Stock of vocabulary — Grammatical rules — Attending English classes regularly — Special coaching — How to practice speaking English.
answer_text:
12, Mirpur Road, Dhaka
14 February 2025
My dear Rosmina,
Have my heartiest love. I have not heard from you for long. I do not know how you are now. Of course well, aren't you? Through Rashed I have come to learn that you have cut a sorry figure in the last Test Examination. The obstacle (প্রতিবন্ধকতা) to good figure is your weakness in English, I think. To do well in the exam you have to improve your English knowledge. Respecting this you can follow the following words of mine. First, you have to widen the stock of vocabulary (শব্দভাণ্ডার). Then grammatical rules in English should be mastered. Here you may pursue the basic grammatical rules. You have to attend English classes regularly. In school you can take special coaching if needed. You have to put emphasis (গুরুত্ব) on thorough reading, writing, listening and speaking. In this case, one should follow the communicative method of learning English language. English spoken course sometimes is lucrative for mastering this method easily. Hope you are feeling ease hearing me. I am stopping here saying you to depend on His mercy (দয়া). Tender my regards to your parents and love to the youngers.
Ever yours,
Kaspian

question_text: Suppose, you are Nasim/Nasima of 50 Kazalshah, Sylhet-3100. You have a best friend named Salam/Salma who lives at 30, Pallabi, Ali Para, Sunamgonj-3070. S/he is a chain smoker. You know that smoking is a bad habit and it causes many fatal illness. Now, write a letter to your friend advising him/her to give up smoking. Use the following clues : — How you know the matter — how many substances a single puff of cigarettes contains — harmful substances — the effects of nicotine — which elements cause cancer — chronic bronchitis — dangerous habit
answer_text:
50 Kazalshah, Sylhet-3100
10 March 2025
My dear Salam,
I am very sorry that you have not written to me for quite a while. It is not at all proper for a friend like you. But I got your news yesterday from your mother's letter. Aunt wrote that you smoke a lot of cigarettes. From her letter I came to know that you become a chain smoker. But my friend! You must know the dangers of smoking. So, why are you taking such a harmful thing? Do you forget that? Look, I tell you— Smoking does a lot of harm. A single puff of cigarette smoke contains 15 billion particles of substances which are very dangerous for health. The most harmful substance in cigarette smoke is nicotine, Methyl, Alcohol, Carbon monoxide, Formaldehyde, Arsenic, Benzopyrene and several other acids. Nicotine contracts the blood vessels and causes blood pressure leading to heart attack. Benzopyrene, arsenic and tobacco cause cancer. The bad effect of smoking leads to chronic bronchitis. Excessive smoking may lead a person to premature death. Such are the fatal effects of smoking. I suggest you to give up smoking just now and never to indulge in such dangerous habit again. Do give up smoking, if you love yourself. I am well. Hope this finds you quite hale and hearty.
Your loving friend,
Nasim

question_text: Imagine, you are Nafis/Nafisa of College Road, Rangpur and recently you have visited your friend Nabila's house at Asian Highway, Chattogram. You have been very much charmed by the worm hospitality of your friend. Now write a letter to your friend thanking her for her hospitality.
answer_text:
College Road, Rajshahi
18 March 2025
Dear Nabila,
I reached home safely (নিরাপদ) yesterday evening, as apparently I had no trouble on my way home. I shall never forget the last few days I spent in your midst. How much care with all the warmth of your heart you all took of me! How solicitous (উৎকণ্ঠিত) and affectionate your parents were! It will be an act of ingratitude (অকৃতজ্ঞতা) on my part if I do not mention the name of your youngest brother, Nafis. Didn't you see how ready he always was for me? I deem, I was the pivot and attraction (আকর্ষণ), for your whole family revolved round me in those few days. How do I forget the recollection (স্মৃতি) of those days I was with you? The memory of my short stay will remain ever fresh in me. Allow me, my dear friend, to convey my heartful thanks to you all for your friendly hospitality (আতিথেয়তা). It is really uncommon nowadays. With best regards to your parents and love to the juniors especially my best wishes for brother Arif.
Yours ever,
Nafisa
flag_note: প্রশ্নে 'worm hospitality' ছাপা (warm-এর বদলে) এবং প্রশ্নে ঠিকানা Rangpur হলেও মডেলের শিরোনামে Rajshahi লেখা — দুটোই যেমন ছাপা তেমন রাখা হয়েছে।

question_text: Imagine you are Sumon/Sumona of 177, Broad Lane, Chattogram. Recently you have gone to a study tour from your school. Now, write a letter to your friend Adib/Adiba who lives at 8/9, Creative Road, Kadirganj, Rajshahi, telling him/her about the tour. Use the following clues. — date of the tour — place of the tour — mode of transport — things you have seen and enjoyed — knowledge gained
answer_text:
177, Broad Lane, Chattogram
30 March 2025
Dear Adib,
How are you and your family members? Hope all are well and hearty by the grace of the Almighty. Today I am writing to you to share a very interesting experience (খুব মজার অভিজ্ঞতা) that I have recently experienced. Actually, I am talking about the recent study tour organised by our school authority. We went to the study tour on the 28th instant of this month. The spot selected for the tour was Cox's Bazar Sea shore (সমুদ্র সৈকত). We hired two luxurious buses for transport. Our journey started at 8 in the morning. Some of our teachers including our class teacher accompanied us in the tour. We took some dry food prepared for the tour. We reached Cox's Bazar about two hours later. Reaching at the sea shore we got astonished. Specially I was so wondered (বিস্মিত হওয়া) as it was my first visit to the sea beach. We have seen a lot of people who gathered there in many groups. Some were bathing in the blue water and some were roaming to and fro with a joyous mood. After roaming (ঘোরাফেরা করা) for about a hour, we were asked to take a snap. Then we took a bath in the sea water. Our teachers told us not go so far in the water. After that our teachers decided to have lunch. We were taken to a hotel named 'Hotel Sea Girls' for lunch. It was really an aristocratic (অভিজাত) one. We enjoyed various sea fishes there. After lunch we took some rest and at the late afternoon we again went to the sea beach to enjoy the sunset scene. It was really a great wonder for us to see the sun setting into the water. The sun seemed to be diving into the sea. After that we went back to our bus and started our return journey. At 9.30 pm we reached Chattogram and returned home soon. It was really a memorable event (স্মরণীয় ঘটনা) in my life. No more today. Hope you will write me soon.
Yours ever,
Sumon

question_text: Imagine you are Arif/Arifa of 7 Dhanmondi, Dhaka. Recently you went on a picnic to Kuakata. Now write a letter to your friend Salam/Salma who lives in Sylhet describing the picnic. Use the following clues : (a) date of the picnic (b) name of the place (c) sights and sounds (d) knowledge you got (e) enjoyments and excitement
answer_text:
7 Dhanmondi, Dhaka
1 April 2025
Dear Salam,
Hoping you to be quite well by the grace of Almighty Allah. I am also well. Friend, you'll be glad to know that recently (সম্প্রতি) I went on a picnic to Kuakata. On March 11, I along with my friend went there by the arrangement of Bengal Tour Company. After a seven and half an hour bus journey we reached there. When we arrived there it was midday. After taking some rest we began to observe the sights and sounds of the sea-beach Kuakata. We heard the roar of the sea. In the meantime the sun was began to set. Seeing the scene of setting sun I was just dumb (বোবা). It seemed to me an unearthy scene. The next morning we went to the same place and surprisingly we observed the sun was peeping (উঁকি দেওয়া) on the same place that it lost another day. The scene will remain in my mind as a lifetime experience. I did not find it easy before telling my experience to you. If you had joined our picnic, surely it would have increased our pleasure. Hoping to join another picnic like this with you. No more today. Best regards to your parents and love to the youngers.
Yours ever,
Arif
flag_note: মডেলে 'unearthy' ও 'the sun was began' ছাপা (unearthly, had begun-এর বদলে) — যেমন ছাপা তেমন রাখা হয়েছে।

question_text: Imagine, you are Rana/Rani of 25 B.K. Road, Khulna. The annual sports of your school have recently been held. You were one of the participants and became champion. Now, write a letter to your friend, Mishu who lives at K.N. Avenue, Bogura, describing the sports day of your school. Use the following clues : — date of the occasion. — place where it was held. — decoration and arrangement. — guests. — events of games. — your personal achievements. — distribution of prizes. — your personal feelings.
answer_text:
25 B.K. Road, Khulna
24 March 2025
My Dear Mishu,
I have some happy news to inform you. Last Monday, 21 March was the annual sports day of our school. It was held on our school playground. In order to celebrate the day the authorities concerned (সংশ্লিষ্ট) decorated the school premises with colourful flags and festoons. There was a nice stage in honour of the invited guests. question_text: Suppose, you are Arif/Afifa from Patuakhali. You have a friend named Masud/Masuda living at 9, Station Road, Dhaka. He/She is a student of class X but he/she is not interested at all to learn English. Now, write a letter to him/her about the importance of learning English in all stages of life.
answer_text:
Patuakhali
12 March 2025
Dear Masud,
I am happy to learn that you have cut very good figure in every subject except English in the half yearly examination. Hearing it, I talked to your English teacher over phone. He informed me that you are quite deficient in English and you are not interested in learning English. It is very disappointing. You know that English is an international language. Wherever you go, you need English and the importance of English in our day to day life is indescribable in words. English is used in every sector. International community and business world use English to communicate across national borders. Today, more than 80% of all the information in the world's computer is in English. So organizations frequently need employees who are adept in English. It is true that English helps one to get good jobs and better salaries. So I advise you to be serious in learning English. No more today. Take care of your health.
Your friend,
Arif

question_text: Suppose your name is Rabi/Rubina. You have a pen-friend in London named James/Jenifer. He/She wants to know about Bangladeshi food. Now write a letter to him/her describing the foods and the food-habits of the people of Bangladesh.
answer_text:
10 R.K. Mission Road
Dhaka, Bangladesh
14 March 2025
Dear James,
Have my love. I am in receipt of your 6th instant letter in which you have wanted to know about Bangladeshi food. Now I am giving you a pen picture of this. Bangladesh is an agro-based country of South Asia where rice and fish are available. Rice is our staple food. It is said that we are 'mache bhate Bangalee' who possess ponds abundant (পরিপূর্ণ) with fish, shed full of cows and granary full of rice. Bangladesh is a country of rivers abundant with fishes of various species. We eat pantha bhat with hilsa as well. There are a lot of herbal foods in our country. These foods come from different vegetables and fruits. Hence these are natural foods. We raise livestock (গবাদিপশু) and eat their flesh cooking usually and on some occasions. We mainly take three square meals daily. During breakfast city dwellers (বাসিন্দা) generally eat bread, fried egg, fried vegetables, biscuits, tea etc. But the villagers at the same time mainly eat pantha bhat to which you are introduced in one of my former letters. The villagers can enjoy fresh vegetables that is almost impossible for the town people. Now the town people are bending to the fast food that is common in your country. A large amount of our people nowadays eat biriani, polao and the like. Khai, muri and chira are well known to our village people. A little portion of our people is bending to Thai and Chinese restaurant at present. Infact the worldwide influence (প্রভাব) of globalisation has already began to level the uneven food habit across the world. But we Bangalee have been forwarding so long with food and food habit that originated with our age-old and prestigious culture. I am putting an ending mark here. Hope you all are hale and hearty in your family.
Your friend,
Rabi

question_text: Imagine, you are Taufiq/Taufiqa of Keshabpur, Jashore. You have a pen-friend named Robert who lives at 12, Derriford Road, Plymouth PL G8 HB, UK. Now, write a letter to him about your native village. Use the following clues : — Location of the village — People and their occupation — Condition of the villagers — Educational institutions — Natural scenery — Why famous.
answer_text:
Keshabpur, Jashore
Bangladesh
14 February 2025
Dear Robert,
Hearty love to you. How are you? OK? So I hope. I am the same as well. Last month you wrote to me that you want to know about my native village. Now be mindful and hark. My village, Domorgram, is in the southern part of Bogura district. It is on the skirt of a vast beel named Beel Gorallia. There are ten thousands people in my village. My village is mainly based on agriculture. Most of them are farmers, many of them are educated and several of them are gracing some high posts of govt. There is block system irrigation (সেচ) in the village. There are around one hundred poultry firms, fifty looms and some other cottage industries in the village. The condition of the villagers is satisfactory in most fields. You will find no man living under poverty line in my village though Bangladesh is a developing country now. This information is surely surprising you. Friend, no wonder that we are forwarding to cope with (সমান তালে চলা) you in the era of globalisation. You are under EU, but we are under NAM, SAARC, OIC etc. Our village is having the modern amenities (সুবিধাবস্তু) of town life. In our village there is a number of educational institutions; college, two high schools, four primary schools, a junior high school, a KG school and three madrashas. question_text: Suppose, you are Anamika/Anik living in Munshigonj. Your friend, Tonima/Tunu who lives in Manikgoanj has lost her/his father last week by a road accident. Now, write a letter to your friend expressing your condolence at her/his father's death.
answer_text:
Munshigonj
13 August 2025
My dear Tonima,
I have just received your letter. Through the letter I have come to know that you have recently lost your father by a road accident. It is very sad to me. I am sure that you are now broken hearted. I have also got very upset. My heart has been filled with sorrows hearing this news. I don't find any view to console (সান্ত্বনা দেওয়া) you. It is no doubt very pathetic. I am sharing utmost pains with you. But I suggest you not to be very upset. You know that man is born to die. As like as other creatures (প্রাণিকুল) man is also mortal. No one lives forever. Each of us has to go back to the eternal Creator. You should believe confidently that Allah is almighty, the only is born of life and death and no human being will be helpless there. As Muslims we ought to exercise our religious faith. Try to avoid sad feelings, wish peace for the departed soul of your father and move onto your daily work. No more words today. With ardent sympathy (সহানুভূতি) to you and your family.
Yours ever,
Anamika

question_text: Suppose, as a student you are sincere in study and alongside your academic study, you read newspapers regularly. Now, write a composition on “The Importance of Reading Newspapers”.
answer_text:
Importance of Reading Newspaper
Newspapers are an important part of our daily lives. They are the primary source of information for most people, providing news and updates from around the world. Reading newspapers is not only informative but also essential for various reasons. It is a habit that should be inculcated in children at an early age. Firstly, reading newspapers helps individuals to keep themselves updated with the latest news and current affairs from around the world. The news on various topics such as politics, sports, business, entertainment, etc. can be accessed in newspapers. One can learn about new laws, policies, and events that are taking place in their own country and abroad. This information is essential as it helps individuals to make informed decisions in their daily lives. Secondly, reading newspapers can enhance an individual's vocabulary and reading skills. Newspapers are written in different styles, and one can learn different writing styles and techniques by reading them. It can also help in improving reading speed and comprehension skills. Thirdly, reading newspapers helps individuals to develop critical thinking skills. As they read different news articles, they can analyze and form opinions on various topics. It also helps in developing analytical skills and broadening an individual's perspective on different issues. Fourthly, reading newspapers can be a source of entertainment for some people. Apart from news, newspapers also provide various columns, puzzles, and games that can be enjoyed by people of all ages. In a nutshell, reading newspapers is an essential habit that individuals should develop. It provides a lot of information that helps in making informed decisions and improving knowledge. Moreover, it also helps in developing various skills such as critical thinking, analytical skills, and vocabulary.

question_text: Write a composition on "Your Favourite Hobby".
answer_text:
My Favourite Hobby/My Hobby/Playing Guitar as My Hobby
A hobby is an activity that someone does for enjoyment or pleasure during their free time. It is usually an activity that is not related to work or other obligations. Hobbies can include anything from sports, music, arts and crafts, cooking, gardening, and more. Different people have different types of tastes, so they have different hobbies. My favourite hobby is playing guitar. It is a great way for me to express myself creatively. It also helps me relax and unwind after a long day. When I first started playing guitar, it was a bit overwhelming. There were so many cords to learn and my fingers would often hurt from pressing down on the strings. But with practice and patience, I soon began to see progress. One of the things I love about playing guitar is the versatility of the instrument. I can play anything from rock to blues to folk music, and it always feels great to learn a new song. Another thing that makes playing guitar so enjoyable is the social aspect of it. I love playing with other musicians and jamming out with friends. It is a great way to connect with others and share a love for music. Playing guitar has also taught me important lessons about discipline and perseverance. It takes time and effort to get better at anything, and the same is true for guitar. But every time I practice, I am improving and getting closer to my goals. In summary, playing guitar is my favourite hobby because it allows me to express myself creatively, relax and unwind, learn new songs, connect with others, and develop important life skills.

question_text: Bangladesh is a land of six seasons. Every season has its own special aspects. You have a great attraction for one of the seasons. Now, write a composition on "The season you like most." (250 words)
answer_text:
The Season I Like Most/Best (The Spring)
Bangladesh is a land of six seasons. Each season has its own features. Of the six seasons of Bangla year, I love the spring most. It is the king of seasons. The spring is one of the most delightful seasons in Bangladesh. It is the season of rebirth, rejuvenation and renewal. It starts in the month of Falgun (February/March) and lasts until Baishakh (April). The weather in spring is simply magical. The bitter cold of winter gradually fades away, and the cool breeze brings a pleasant feeling all around. There is no heavy rainfall, no dark cloud, or no scorching heat of summer. The bright sunshine and blue skies enhance the beauty of nature. The spring comes with the message of hope and enjoyment. The trees and plants put on new leaves. The nature wears a charming look. The flowers bloom everywhere, and the trees turn lush green, making the entire country look vibrant and colourful. One of the best things about spring in Bangladesh is the festivals that come along with it. Pohela Falgun, the first day of spring, is celebrated with much enthusiasm and joy. People dress up in bright and colourful clothes, and the streets are decorated with flowers and banners. Basanta Utsav, the festival of colours, is also celebrated during this season. Another reason why I love spring is that it is the perfect season for outdoor activities. The mild weather makes it ideal for outdoor sports, travelling, picnic, etc. In addition, birdwatchers can indulge in their hobby, as some species of migratory birds visit this country during this season. Overall, spring is the season that brings hope, happiness, and a fresh start to everyone. With its mild weather, colourful landscapes, and festive celebrations, it is no wonder that it is one of the most loved seasons in the country.

question_text: Write a composition on “A Journey You have Recently Made.”
answer_text:
A Journey by boat I Enjoyed/A Journey by boat
A journey by boat can be a tranquil and peaceful experience, where one can enjoy the serene beauty of nature and the rhythmic flow of water. I recently had the opportunity to enjoy a boat trip and it was an experience that I will never forget. It was an autumn vacation. I enjoyed a journey by boat from Mymensingh to Jamalpur along the river Brahmaputra. The journey started early in the morning when we boarded a wooden boat. The boat was not very big, but it was comfortable and had enough space for all of us. We were a group of eight people, including two boatmen. As we set off, the sun was just rising, and the sky was filled with hues of orange and red. The weather was calm, and we could see the reflection of the sky on the surface of the river. As we left the din and bustle of the town behind, the riverine Bangladesh greeted us with its vast water stretching as far as the eyes could see. It reminded us of the past trading activities through riverways. We passed by small villages on the banks of the river, and we saw people going about their daily lives. Some were fishing, others were bathing or washing their clothes. The boat journey took us through different waterways, including canals and streams, where we saw a variety of birdlife. We saw herons, kingfishers, and many other species of birds. The scenery was stunning, with green fields and trees lining the banks of the waterways. At about 10 a.m, we stopped at a small village along the riverside. We had the chance to explore the village and interact with the locals. They were very friendly and hospitable. We bought some snacks for breakfast. Back on the boat, we enjoyed the traditional snacks and tea while taking in the sights and sounds of the river. One of the highlights of the journey was when we stopped at a village to take our lunch. We saw there how the locals make traditional pottery. The potters skillfully shaped the clay into different objects, such as pots, cups, and plates. We even had the opportunity to try our hand at making some pottery ourselves, which was a lot of fun. The journey lasted for several hours, and we enjoyed every moment of it. It was a great way to experience the natural beauty of our country and learn more about the local culture. I would highly recommend a boat journey to anyone who loves nature and adventure. However, a boat journey is a fantastic experience that I will never forget. It offers a unique perspective on the country's natural beauty and cultural heritage. I hope to have the opportunity to do it again someday.

question_text: Write a composition on ‘Your Favourite Game' in about 250 words.
answer_text:
My Favourite Game/ The Game I Like Most
All games are not equally amusing and interesting to us. Among the games I have a great fascination for football which is a popular game all over the world. It is full of thrill for both the players and spectators. It is an excellent form of exercise that makes the players strong and stout. These are the reason for which I like football more than all other games. The game is played between two teams each consisting of eleven players. Of them there is a goalkeeper who prevents the ball from crossing the goalline. There are two full backs standing at a little distance from the goal posts. There are three half backs in a line midway between the forwards and backs who act both as defenders and offenders. There are five other players who play in the forward line. They try to push the ball through the goal posts. The whole game is divided into two equal halves with an interval of fifteen minutes. At the end of the first half each team changes its side. The game is generally played for ninety minutes. In the field the referee is the supreme authority to conduct the game. His decision is final. Two lines men assist him to run the game smoothly and properly. During the play no player except the goalkeeper can touch the ball with hands. No player in the game can make any foul, In case of making any foul the referee can send any player off the field. The victory goes to the team that can score more goals than the other. The game of football teaches us the principle of obedience to rules. It fosters the spirit of love, discipline and co-operation among the players. It develops team spirit and sportsmanship in the players. There is nothing which is an unmixed blessing. Too much involvement in the game often makes students apathetic towards their studies. Rivalry in the play often leads to quarrell among the supporters in the gallery and spoils the thrill and joy of the game. Sometimes it goes to touch extent that the whole ground turns into a battle field. But inspite of having some negative sides, football is the most popular and exciting game in the world.
