question_text: Write a composition on "Satellite TV channels and our young generation".
answer_text:
Satellite TV Channels and Our young Generation
Satellite is a machine that has been sent into space (মহাকাশ) and goes round the earth, moon, etc. It is used for radio, television and other electronic communications. On the contrary, channel means a station by which various types of programmes are broadcast. Satellite channels are those that are able to broadcast programmes globally. They play a very important role in providing us with amazement and amusement. Amusing lives cannot be imagined without satellite channels. Through satellite channels we can enjoy educational, literary, cultural and entertaining games and sports programmes. They enrich our mind and mentality with international life awakening flow. They introduce us to global culture and custom. Therefore, their utility in our modern life cannot be denied. There are various satellite channels. They are Desh TV, ATN, Channel I, ETV, RTV, Baishakhi, Bangla Vision, Zee Cinema, Star Plus, Star Movies, Star Sports, Sony, ESPN, National Geography, Al-Jajeera, Cartoon Network, BBC, CNN, AXN, ZTV, MTV, HBO, PTV, and what not. It is true that satellite channels are of great use to us. But they are not an unmixed blessing for us. By broadcasting nude programmes some channels provoke juvenile delinquency. The young generation is losing their social values by watching foreign programmes. By watching vulgar films they go to dogs. Social crimes like killing, raping, kidnapping, robbing are committed owing to the influence of satellite channels. Therefore, effective steps should be taken to save our young generation from deterioration (ধ্বংস) caused by satellite channels.

question_text: Nowadays people are suffering from various diseases. If they take physical exercise everyday, they can enjoy a sound health. Now, write a composition on "The Importance of Physical Exercise".
answer_text:
Physical Exercise/ The Importance of Physical Exercise
We have a mind as well as a body. There is an intimate relation between the two. A sound mind goes with a sound body. Physical exercise keeps our body healthy and our mind in proper condition. Physical exercise means the movement of the limbs. It makes one strong and active and keeps one away from diseases. There are various kinds of physical exercise. Swimming, running, walking, riding are good forms of exercise. Gymnastics, wrestling are also good kinds of exercise. Modern outdoor games like football, cricket, hockey, tennis are good physical exercises, too. The village games are the best physical exercise. All forms of exercise are not suitable for all men. If a weak man takes part in a game of football or hockey, he will get tired. Such exercise does him more harm than good. So he should take a milder form of exercise. For young men gymnastics, wrestling and outdoor games are very suitable. There are people who work hard to earn their living. They need not take physical exercise. Again, over exercise does harm to health. So, we should always take such exercise as would suit us. Physical exercise is necessary to develop the brain. A healthy man enjoys life better and has greater happiness. A weak man sees a bear in every bush. He falls an easy prey to disease and death. Many students only sit with their books and refuse to take any exercise. They are soon seen to decline in health. They fall victim to various kinds of diseases, life becomes a burden to them and the world seems to be a prison house to them. Our body is just like an engine. If it is not put in regular service, it may be easily spoiled. So, without regular exercise, we cannot expect to enjoy sound health. We should take some kinds of physical exercise to improve our health.

question_text: Write a composition on "Duties of a Student" within 250 words.
answer_text:
Duties of a Student
Students are the future citizens of the country. So, it is their main duty to acquire knowledge. As they are the future leaders, they need to have a sound education which will enable them to do good to the nation. They should also render social services during leisure time or during long vacations. The students have youthful vigour and consequently energy, warmth and inspiration. Students should devote themselves to the service of the society. They can also organize welfare centers of humanitarian (মানবকল্যাণমূলক) services among the poor and needy. The students can do a lot to remove illiteracy by educating the people in the proper way. They may conduct night schools and instruct the ignorant about their homeland's history, moral values, evils of superstition, need of co-operation, laws of health and social life, duties as citizens etc. Bangladesh is an agricultural country. But the farmers are not aware of the modern system of cultivation. The students can convince the people of the utility of modern methods of cultivation. They can motivate people to grow more food. An ideal student must keep himself ready to sacrifice his supreme pleasure at the time of need. They must make a proper utilization of their time, take good care of their health, develop their mental faculty by doing co-curricular activities, practising honesty, truthfulness, piety and kindness in every step of their life.

question_text: Write a composition on "Your Future Plan of Life".
answer_text:
My Aim in Life/ My Future Plan of Life/ The Profession you like to take up in Future
Human being is the best creation of God. He is a rational animal. Every man, who lives in the society, has an aim in life. Without it none can make progress. The man, who has no aim in life, is like a ship without a rudder. But a fixed aim helps a man to shine in life. So, it is essential for every man. Planning for future is essential for an individual life. So, a man should choose an aim for future life. But different persons have different tastes and aims. There are many professions in the world. So, it is difficult to choose a correct one. Some want to earn money, some want to earn fame, some want to serve the people. I want neither money nor fame. I want to serve the people of my locality. With this noble idea I have chosen to be a doctor. Bangladesh is a very poor country. The living standard (জীবনমান) of the people of our country is very low. They are not aware of the rules of health. They suffer from many diseases. They are illiterate about what kind of food is essential for them. I have seen how the people of my village suffer from diseases every year and die without treatment and medical help. The people of our country suffer from superstition and many of them fall into this trap. So, I have decided to become a doctor and serve my poor and illiterate villagers. After passing the HSC examination in science group, I shall get myself admitted into MBBS course in Dhaka Medical College or others. Obtaining the highest degree in medical science, I shall go to my native village to serve the people of my locality. I shall set up a charitable dispensary in our village market. I shall treat the poor patients without fees. Medical profession is the noblest of all professions. It brings money and love of man. To serve the distressed humanity is to serve God. I want to live in the memory of mass people even after my death. So, I have decided to become a doctor. To become successful in life, every man should choose the profession carefully. I think my choice is the best one for my life and for the lives of villagers.

question_text: Science has become an inevitable part of the life of modern man. We find the active presence of science in almost every step of our day to day life. Write a composition on "Science in Everyday Life" stating what are the common gifts of science to make our life comfortable, why these have become a part and parcel of everyday life and how life would be if science stops facilitating.
answer_text:
Science in Everyday Life
We can't imagine our life without science. It is associated with us greatly. Modern life cannot be thought without science. It has made our life easier and comfortable. We feel sound because of its so many gifts. They have removed our sufferings to a great extent. We see innumerous blessings of science in our daily life. Electricity, motor vehicles, domestic appliances, TV, Radio, Radar, aeroplane, ship, computer etc have made our life easier and comfortable. Science has relieved human sufferings. Electricity is a wonderful creation of science. With it we run domestic appliances, mills, factories, machines of various kinds and the liking. Without electricity life would come to a standstill (স্থবির). Now we can travel any place of the world quickly. Fast moving vehicles like motor bus, cars, trains and aeroplanes have saved our time. We can travel miles after miles within a short span of time. Concord plane can take us from Bangladesh to New York, even, in two hours. Actually, vehicles have given us speed in our life. Education has been made easier by the goodness of science. Printing press has made books cheap and available to masses. Thousands of books and magazines are printed and widely circulated by scientific means within very short time. All these spread education among people. Telephone, telegram, fax, telex, wireless (বেতার) work like miracles. E-mail and mobile phones have brought out changes in communication. We can now talk to near ones as well as see the persons talking with. The use of computer has done unbelievable advancement in communication. Radio and television have conquered space, time and object. We see the whole world in our drawing room through dish antenna. Scientific methods have made cultivation and irrigation easier. Power tiller, power pump have enhanced agricultural activities. Scientific tools have made life long. They have lessened human sufferings to a great extent. A modern hospital cannot run without the help of modern science. Life saving medicines x-ray, ultrasonograph, ECG etc have made it easier to identify diseases. We see everywhere the influence of science. Its blessings are innumerable (অসংখ্য) and we are blessed with it. We need to make the proper use of science in our practical life.

question_text: Students are the future leaders of society. They can contribute to the society not only with their education but also with other services. Write a composition on "Students and Social Services".
answer_text:
Students and Social Service
As students are the future leaders, they need to have a sound education which will enable them to do good to the nation. They should render social services during leisure or long vacations. The students have youthful vigour and energy, warmth and inspiration. Students should devote themselves to the service of the society. They can organize social service squads in their respective institutions to work in different areas. They can also organize welfare centers of humanitarian services among the poor and needy. The students can do a lot in removing illiteracy by educating the people in a proper way. They may conduct night schools and instruct the ignorant about their homeland's history, moral values, evils of superstition, need of co-operation, rules of health and social life, duties as citizens etc. Bangladesh is an agricultural country. But the farmers are not aware of the modern scientific methods of cultivation. The students can convince the people of the utility of modern methods of cultivation. They can motivate people to grow more food. In critical positions of the country, students must lead the country. As the students can nurse the wounded in the field of war, they can save life of many soldiers. Bangladesh faces natural calamities every year. During these disasters, the students can help the distressed people. Students must keep themselves ready to sacrifice their supreme pleasure at the time of danger. Then and only then he or she will be regarded as the crown of the deprived people because, they are the selfless sections of the society. Their services are regarded as noble deeds. So, they must take active part in these noble deeds.

question_text: Computer is one of the most essential machines in modern world. It is commonly thought as a substitute of human brain as it works automatically and unbelievably faster than human brain. Write a composition on "The uses of computer in every day life" stating why modern men use it, what are the obvious benefits of using it and how computer has become as inevitable part of a modern man's life.
answer_text:
The uses of Computer in Everyday Life
The latest wonder of science that has added a new dimension to the modern civilization is computer. It is the machine by which the science is trying to substitute human brain. The use of computer is immense. There is hardly any sector of modern human activities where computer is not used. Space technology, medical science, defense, scientific research, administration etc. cannot do without the use of computer. Our everyday life is also greatly involved in using computer. In the field of education computer plays an important role. Very important books, dictionary, scientific invention, discovery, medical research etc. are launched through internet. Student can be greatly benefited by browsing these sites in computer. For exchanging information computer is very effective. We can be informed of the happenings (ঘটনাপ্রবাহ) around the world within a very short time through internet. We can read newspaper, journals, information about various institutions, companies, products of various brands, sports news etc. through computer. Act of business is also being performed through computer. Computer has made the banking activities easier and more reliable. Balance check, money transfer, deposit, withdrawal etc. can be done by the credit card with the help of computer. Offices can do little without using computer. Corresponding with others, printing text, making documents, calculating, data processing, data finding etc. are performed in the offices very quickly and correctly through computer. In the field of transport computer plays an importants role. Trains and planes are run with the help of computer. It is used for preparing electric bill, telephone bill, gas bill, water bill. The entire function of mobile communication is regulated by computer. The function of stock exchange is regulated by computer. It is also a component of recreation. Children use it for playing game. Adults also use it for watching movie and enjoying music. Infact, the use of computer in the present world is endless. We can't think our modern life without computer. It can be said that the development of a country depends to some extent on using computer.

question_text: Trees are essential for the existence of human and animals in this world. So, to live in a habitable atmosphere, trees should be planted as many as possible for the sake of our own lives. Write a composition on "Tree plantation/ Importance of Trees in our daily life" narrating why trees are so important and how we can plant more trees in a regular basis.
answer_text:
Importance of Trees in Our Daily Life/ Tree plantation/ Why do you think more trees should be planted
Trees are our first friends both for our soul and sole existence. We cannot live anyhow beyond five minutes without taking oxygen that trees give off taking in carbon-dioxide. Trees, therefore, preserve our physical subsistence (অস্তিত্ব) first. Then trees are playing vital role in nature. These are protecting severe green house effect, resisting the unbridled erosion of soil and fighting as massive prevention against various natural disasters and disorders maintaining the interrelation among components of nature. We are preparing residence under the shady haunts of trees, nature's greatest boon. We eat to live for which we need food and trees are the container of food of various species. We are using various vehicles some of which are made of wood and wood's begetter is tree. Lots of edifice buildings (সুরম্য অট্টালিকা) of the world are the direct contribution of trees. Trees always function in our construction sphere. All these contributions of trees are the bodily ones. Tress obviously control our mental hemisphere no doubt. Trees are the ornament of our beauty queen nature. Various sorts of flowers of each and every season are giving manifold (বহুমুখী) shapes of our nature. Various festivals are being well accomplished in the appealing and colourful environment for the usual presence of fragrant and colourful flowers. In the ocular world we are using many things majority of which directly or indirectly are linked with trees whose medicinal qualities (ঔষধি গুণ) are needless to note here. Trees are the fathers of herbal chemistry that is constantly influencing our daily life. In broader sense, one can say in fine that from cradle to grave or burning ghat trees are the greatest functionaries in his daily life. To sum up, trees are saving us from the different natural malady (ব্যাধি).
flag_note: মডেলে 'Tress' ছাপা (Trees-এর বদলে) — যেমন ছাপা তেমন রাখা হয়েছে।

question_text: Write a composition on "Importance of Tree Plantation".
answer_text:
Importance of Tree Plantation/ Afforestation/ Importance of Planting more Trees/ The necessity of tree plantation/ Tree Plantation/ Why do you think more trees should be planted
Since the dawn (উষালগ্ন) of civilization man has a close relation with nature. Nature helps us in many ways. Trees are the indispensable (অবিচ্ছেদ্য) part of nature. They are the gifts of nature. Tree gives us 'Oxygen'. But for the development of human civilization this valuable assets are damaged day by day. For the Rabindranath Tagore says, ‘Give back the forest, take your town”. By these lines he tries to tell us about the importance of trees. So, tree plantation is very important for our life and economy. The people of our country cut down trees at random. So, our country is losing her trees. If this process continues, she will turn into a desert. It is a perfect time that we plant trees to protect our environment. To preserve our environment, we should plant more and more trees. Government order may be passed in order to make the people interested in planting trees. They should be made aware that our economy is dependent on trees. Trees bear a great impact (প্রভাব) on the climate. If we destroy trees at random, one day the country will turn into a great desert. The country will bear the consequences (পরিণাম) of Green House Effect. Again there will be no rain and as a result, the country will face a great crisis because ours is an agricultural country and our economy is dependent on agriculture. Again our agriculture depends on rain. So trees play a vital role on our climate. Trees keep the soil strong. Trees save us from flood and many other natural calamities. There is a model for afforestation (বনায়ন) in Bangladesh. Sea beaches, low lying areas and fallowlands (পতিত জমি) can be brought under the scheme of afforestation with special types of trees suited to the soil. Shady trees and fruit trees should be planted by the side of roads and high ways. Trees may be planted in all sides of ponds and dighis in village. June and July are the best time for tree plantation. Tree plantation programme should be expanded to the remote corner of the country. Most of the people of our country do not know about the utility and the importance of trees and forests. For this reason government should make TV programme or radio programme on the subjects of afforestation. Trees are part and parcel of our life. So, it is our duty to plant more trees and take care of them in order to maintain balance between man and nature.

question_text: Write a composition on "Wonders of Modern Science".
answer_text:
Wonders/ Blessings of Modern Science
Modern civilization is the gift of science. The wonders and blessings of science beggar description. The wonders of modern science are too many to illustrate them in a short essay. Electricity, Telephone, Television, Radio, Cinema, Aeroplane, Rocket, Telegraph, Computer, E-mail, Internet, X-ray, Nuclear energy etc. are the highest blessings and wonders of modern science. Electricity is the driving force of modern civilization. It gives power and energy. Man can now remove the darkness of his room by turning a small switch. Radio is one of the marvellous inventions of modern science. It carries our small voice to the farthest corner of the world. It gives us news, songs, discussions, play, poetry etc. Television is another wonder of modern science. It is another popular medium of communicating thoughts and opinions. It is a great improvement over Radio. Radio pleases only our sense of hearing but television pleases our senses of sight and hearing at the same time. It was invented by Bayard in 1926. Computer is one of the greatest wonders of modern science. It is substitute for the human brain. It is the latest means of communication of thoughts and ideas. In every sphere of life man has been using this wonder of modern science. Science has done great wonders in the field of medicine and treatment of patients. The X-ray, the Pathological diagnostic devices, the Penicillin have come as real blessings to humanity. Space travel is the most wonderful success of modern science. It is possible only for invention of rocket. So, it is possible now to turn man's imagination into reality. Even scientists think of human habitation and colonization on the space. Modern science is not an unmixed blessing. Nuclear weapons may destroy the world any time. The sample of Hiroshima still stays as a nightmare experience. Science is meant for the benefit of mankind. But man misuses this heavenly gift out of his selfish motive and brings unspeakable sufferings to human life. So, the gifts of science should be utilized for the welfare of mankind. Inventions of modern science should be used as blessings. Let this gigantic power be applied for the greater harmony and welfare of the mankind.

question_text: Flood is a common natural calamity in Bangladesh which occurs almost every year. Now, write a composition on "Recent floods in Bangladesh".
answer_text:
Recent Floods in Bangladesh
Flood is a natural calamity. Almost every year it occurs in Bangladesh. Then our miseries know no bounds. It causes untold sufferings to lives. Lives are lost also, valuable riches and resources are destroyed, crops are damaged, domestic animals are washed away, trees and plants are uprooted, roads and high ways are damaged. In fact, flood causes indescribable loss to lives and properties. Now a question can be raised here why flood occurs in our country. In fact, Bangladesh is a low lying country. Besides, environment pollution severely occurs here. On the contrary, our neighbouring country India opens Farakka barage during the rainy season and flood water enters in our country. However, in 2004 flood occurred in Bangladesh. Almost every district went under water. Then human miseries knew no bounds. Relief materials were provided to the flood affected people but those were very much scanty. Besides, some relief materials were also stolen. In 2007 flood also occurred in our country. This flood also caused untold miseries to the affected people. But people were not deprived of relief goods and materials. Because of the fact that there is no political government at that time, the caretaker government strictly distributed relief materials among the affected people. No mismanagement and misappropriation of relief goods has not been heard. The affected people were also heavily pleased by having sufficient relief goods. It's really a matter of great credit. This government has also taken decision to provide the flood affected people with permanent solution, that is, those who are affected by flood are supposed to be rehabilitated. It's a good decision. However, as flood occurs in our country, precautionary steps should be taken to minimise losses caused by it. Otherwise hopes and aspirations will be shattered by the rocks of reality.

question_text: A journey is always pleasant to all. Suppose, you have recently made a journey by train. Now, write a composition on "A Journey by Train" narrating how much you have enjoyed the journey.
answer_text:
A Journey by Train
A train is a quick and mechanized means of modern transport. So a journey by train is always fast. But it is interesting and comfortable as well. A journey by train is now a days popular and less expensive. I was expecting a long journey by train. The chance came in the last autumn. It was a very happy occasion of uncle's wedding ceremony. The function was held in Sylhet town. So we had to go from Dhaka to Sylhet, and it was really a long journey. We reached Dhaka Railway Station at Kamalpur at 6:30 a.m. Our train was the Parabot Express. It was due to leave at 7:00 a.m. We were a group of 20 people. All got on the train in time. We all had our seats reserved in the same compartment. I heard an announcement. Only three minutes later the guard blew the whistle and waved the green flag. The train started on time with a long whistle. The speed rose gradually. The train left behind stations after stations. It passed over many fields, rivers and canals. I was always gazing outside at the natural beauties. It seemed that the trees and the houses near the railway tracks were runing back. But the things at a distance appeared to be running forward with us. When we were near Sylhet, it passed through some tea gardens. I found some women picking tea leaves. I was charmed with all these beauties. But I was impressed most with the waving sight on the surface of green corn fields and the beauty of the tea gardens. All these gave me a wonderful experience. The train reached Sylhet at 8 p.m. We were received at the station by the host party. Thus the journey ended with pleasure and enjoyment. It is still fresh in my memory.

question_text: Computer is an essential device of modern science. It has become a companion in our everyday life. Now write a composition on 'Computer as a Wonderful Gift'. You must mention the history of the invention of computer, its major components, how does it work, in which spheres and in which purposes is it used etc.
answer_text:
Computer as a Wonderful Gift/ Blessing of Computer
Computer is one of the greatest wonders of modern science. Present is the age of computer no doubt. Without computer modern civilization is incomplete, to say the truth. Computer was not invented overnight (রাতারাতি). Charles Babbage at first invented an analytical engine or calculating machine. In 1642 Claily Pascal invented a calculating machine that could do the work of addition and subtraction. In 1671 God fried Habnits devised a calculating machine that could do the work of multiplication and division. In 1812 Charles Babbage planned the basic principles of modern calculator. In 1944 an electro mechanical computer was invented by the concerted effort (ঐক্যবদ্ধ প্রচেষ্টা) of Harvard University and IBM, and now the course of computer is in euphoric (ভ্রমরমা) situation. A computer consists of five major components. They are— (i) input unit (ii) out put unit (iii) memory unit (iv) control unit and (v) arithmetic unit. A computer mainly performs three functions. (i) It receives data (ii) It processes data by various computations (iii) It emits data. Computer renders great service to mankind. It has lessened our work and given us more comfort. It is being used in all spheres of our life likely education, medical science, agriculture, commerce, printing industry and so forth. Computer is also a source of income. Not only the developed country but also a developing country like us uses computer in various jobs. Effective measures should be taken to make computer cheaper and more available in our country. There is no denying that computer has transcended (অতিক্রম করেছে) the classicism of scientific civilization. It has made our activities more speedy than that of Rip Van Winkle.
flag_note: মডেলে ঐতিহাসিক নামগুলো 'Claily Pascal' ও 'God fried Habnits' ছাপা — যেমন ছাপা তেমন রাখা হয়েছে।

question_text: Various types of fruit are found in Bangladesh. They are of different colours, sizes and tastes. Now write a composition on 'Fruits of Bangladesh' mentioning the name of some common fruits of our country, in which seasons they are grown, in which parts of our country they are grown, what is the benefit of cultivating fruits etc.
answer_text:
Fruits of Bangladesh
Bangladesh is enriched (সমৃদ্ধ) with various gifts of nature. Fruit is one of the valuable natural gifts. The suitable land and climate help her to grow different kinds of fruits in different seasons. There are many kinds of fruits in Bangladesh. Fruits of different colours, sizes and tastes grow here. Some are solid, some are juicy, some are big, some are small, some are sweet and some are sour. Our fruits may be classified into two groups. They're all seasonal fruits and seasonal fruits. There are some fruits which grow in all the seasons of the year, among these the banana, the coconut, the papaw, the guava, the lemon are the most popular. The banana is a common fruit of Bangladesh. It is grown in all the districts and all the seasons. Munsigonj and Narsingdi are famous for banana. Banana has several varieties such as Sagore, Shabri, Chapa, Agniswar etc. It is very nutritious (পুষ্টিকর) and sweet. Papaw is a delicious fruit. It keeps the liver function active. The papaw is grown in all the districts and in all seasons. The coconut is a common fruit of Bangladesh. It grows in all seasons. Its water is a sweet drink and its kernel is a tasty food. The mango, the orange, the lichi, the black-berry, the jack fruits, the pineapple etc. grow in different seasons. The mango is the most remarkable fruit of Bangladesh. It is called the king of fruits. It grows in all districts of Bangladesh. It has many varieties such as Fazli, Langra, Mohanbhog, Gophalbhog etc. Rajshahi, Dinajpur, Chapai-Nawabgonj and Bogura produce the best kind of mangoes. Ordinary mangoes are grown in every part of Bangladesh. Jack fruit is our national fruit. It grows in the rainy season. It is the biggest of all fruits in size. It is a great source of vitamin. It grows largely in the districts of Dhaka, Mymensingh and Chattogram and also grows in every parts of the country. Pineapple is a flashy and juicy fruit. It is very nutritious. It's found in the rainy season. It grows mostly in Madhupur, Tangail. It also grows in Sylhet, Chattogram, Cumilla and Mymensingh districts. Lichi is a small juicy fruit. Rajshahi is famous for lichi. If we want more fruits, we should plant more fruit trees in our gardens and houses because, they're important sources of vitamins. They also bring foreign currency. So, we should be active in the cultivation of fruits.

question_text: Bangladesh is a small country but she is burdened with a huge population. This huge population has become one of the greatest problems for the country. Write a composition on "Population problem of Bangladesh" describing why population is a great problem, what can be done to get rid of it and how family planning can be made fruitful.
answer_text:
Population Problem in Bangladesh
Naturally population of a country is an asset (সম্পদ), it becomes a problem when the country cannot afford to give people the basic necessaries of life. In our country population is considerably a major problem because we have no ability to manage the large population. Poor agricultural production, superstition (কুসংস্কার), natural calamities are also responsible for lengthening (দীর্ঘায়নের জন্য দায়ী) this problem. Population Problem is the burning question of our country. Bangladesh is a densely populated country in the world and in respect of population she is the eighth largest. As a result, she cannot afford to provide her people the basic rights because our wealth is limited. So, the standard of our living is much lower than the other developed nations of the world. Moreover, the primitive agricultural system in our country cannot produce sufficient (পর্যাপ্ত) food to keep pace with the growth of population. The main cause of the increase of population is the ignorance and prejudices of the people. 85% of the population are illiterate. They can't realize the gravity of the problem of over-population and do nothing to check it. Moreover, they know very little about family planning. To solve this problem. The people of Bangladesh are still superstitious (কুসংস্কারাচ্ছন্ন). Only a few percentage is educated. As a result, people do not understand the gravity of the problem. Therefore, to curb this population, wide publicity of the danger of over population must be given first priority. Mass education is a powerful weapon (শক্তিশালী অস্ত্র) to overcome the problem. The rapid birth rate can be effectively checked through family planning. Early marriage should be stopped. Each couple must not have more than two children. So, the family planning workers visit every house and convince people of the usefulness of family planning. It is high time to literate our farmers for developing our agricultural sector. It is well known to all that there is huge wealth hidden under the ground of Bangladesh. If these mineral resources are utilized, the present population will not be a burden on the part of Bangladesh. Lastly avenues of employment should be found out. If the people are busy at work in factories and offices, population growth will be curbed. The cloud of over population has begun to disperse. The family planning is now being popularised day by day. We hope, Bangladesh will also succeed in controlling her population like all the western countries in time to come.

question_text: A fair is a unique part of a village culture. It is a cosmopolitan festival for the rural people. Write a composition on "A village Fair" narrating when and how it is arranged or held, what are its social, economic and cultural significances and why is it so important in the life of the villagers.
answer_text:
A Village Fair
A village fair is a centre of assembly for the villains. A village fair needs no advertisement, Everyone knows when and where it is going to be held. In a village fair there is an arrangement of selling and buying, gambling, jugglery and cultural function. It is one kind of bazar or hat. Generally the stalls of the fair are neatly decorated. The shops are arranged according to the articles. There is one row of agricultural goods and tools, in another row agricultural and horticultural products, vegetables, flower plants and saplings. A part of the fair field is specially kept separate. In a huge pandal cinema, films, theatres, magic shows and folk songs follow one another night after night. A fair is held chiefly for trade. The arrangement of amusement makes business pleasant. But it has also an educational value. We learn where things are made and what economic progress there has been in a locality and we able to meet and mix with a variety of people. In fact, the usefulness of a village fair is beyond description (বর্ণনাতীত). The village fair is a crowd of the villagers who gather there to gratify their multifarious pursuits. To arrange a fair annually in the villages is a tradition of the Bangalees. Such an age old tradition is and will be going on for the unlimited times to come. The appeal of the village fair is eternal and everlasting in the mind of the simple and facileheart (কোমল হৃদয়) of the villagers of our village based country. A village fair is inevitable and a must for the villagers to forget the past pains of life.
flag_note: মডেলে 'villains' ও 'facileheart' ছাপা (villagers, facile heart-এর বদলে বলে মনে হয়) — যেমন ছাপা তেমন রাখা হয়েছে।

question_text: A village market is a popular place for the villagers for buying and selling daily commodities. Now write a composition on 'A village Market'. You must mention the place of a village market, what types of commodities are sold in it, what is the socio-economic value of it and what are some demerits of it.
answer_text:
A Village Market
A market which sits in the village is called a village market. It is a very useful place for the villagers. There are two kinds of village market. They are the daily market and the weekly market. The daily market is called 'bazar'. It sits daily in the morning and breaks up before noon. The weekly market is called 'hat'. It sits once or twice a week in the afternoon and breaks up late in the evening. A village market is broadly divided into three parts : open space, temporary sheds and permanent sheds. Here things are brought and sold after close haggling (দরকষাকষি) between buyers and sellers. The fish market is the most crowded part of the market. The prices of things are generally cheaper in a village market. A village market is useful to the village people in a number of ways. It helps them sell their surplus goods and buy their necessaries. It saves them from the troubles of going distant places for buying and selling things. It also helps them carry on business. It is a good meeting place for them. They assemble, gossip and discuss everything in the sky. Thus a village market is like a parliament for the village people. A village market is not free from defects. It has a bad effect on the morality of the children. Villagers very often quarrel over trifling matters (ছোট-খাট বিষয়). It is a very dusty and noisy place. It pollutes environment and affects health. Pick-pockets and gamblers come here and do their evils. A village market is a part and parcel of our rural economy.

question_text: There are various types of journeys in which different types of vehicles are used. Now write a composition on your favourite journey. Justify your liking by comparing it to other types of journey.
answer_text:
The Journey I Like Most
Journeys are an inseparable part of a man's life. Man has been making journey from time immemorial (প্রাগৈতিহাসিক কাল থেকে). Today in the age of globalization the importance of journey has increased too much. In fact man nowadays travels for different purposes. There are three ways for travelling. They are water ways, land ways and air ways. These three ways include different transports like train, bus, boat, launch, aeroplane etc. One can make a journey by any of these transports. For instance, one can make a journey by boat, by launch, by bus, by train or by aeroplane. But of all the transports I like a journey by train most. First of all a train is a speedy transport. It moves following time table. Besides, travelling by a train is comfortable. Above all, a train is a environment friendly transport. A bus, the most common transport of our country, is not so comfortable as a train. A bus bumps while moving. Besides, a bus faces accidents more frequently than a train. A train moves smoothly that is really comfortable. A boat journey is comfortable but it is not so speedy as a train. We cannot go to a distant place by a boat. A journey by launch is also comfortable but we cannot go to all the places by a launch. Besides, it is also a slow transport. Air is a very expensive transport. It is beyond most people's means. Besides, we cannot go everywhere by an aeroplane. Because aeroplanes move to a few routes where there is an airport. In view of these matters I like train journey most. Like the developed countries railways should be developed in our country on a large scale.

question_text: Computer is a great invention of modern science. It is widely used in the developed countries of the world. Now write a composition on 'The Uses of Computer in Bangladesh'. Specially, highlight in which sectors of Bangladesh computer can be used, what facilities it can give to us and what should we do to spread these facilities across the country.
answer_text:
The uses of Computer in Bangladesh
Computer is an electronic machine through which any data can be preserved and output can be received very easily and rapidly. It is a fairly recent invention. It is a wonderful invention of modern science and technology. It is very important in Bangladesh. It has greatly benefited us and brought about revolutionary changes (বৈপ্লবিক পরিবর্তন) in our life. Computer works wonderfully and effectively. Many are the uses of computers. They help perform the works of the students, doctors, businessmen, publishers, bankers, scientists, interpreters, people working in defense, transport and communication departments etc. Thus in almost every fields computer is used. Using computer we get huge benefits. Computers can handle millions of problems in a few seconds. It can solve complex mathematical problems quickly and accurately. It can also perform many operations at one and the same time without any confusion. It can play chess or even compose music. This is why people call it an electronic brain. But unfortunately, in our country especially in the remote areas, computers are not yet to be introduced. People are still not efficient to use computer. To introduce it to the common people, much emphasis should be given on training of computer and spread of computer across the country. Up to date computer courses should be introduced as compulsory. All the firms should be computerised. Thus the common people will get maximum benefits. Besides, steps should be taken to cheapen the prices of computer. Then people of all classes can use it easily.

question_text: Childhood is the most memorable part in every man's life. It is full of many sweet incidents. Now write a composition on 'Your Childhood Memories'. Try to mention how did you pass your childhood with your parents, your school experience, any special occasion in your family, your village life etc.
answer_text:
My Childhood Memories/ Some Sweet Recollection of My Childhood
My childhood days were beautiful. It is really sweet to remember the days of my childhood. Now, I am a grown up man. All my days aren't equally happy. So, I remember my golden childhood to feel happy again. I was the youngest son of my parents. So, all the members of family loved me very much. They gave me everything. They took a great care of me. They bought for me nice toys. My grandmother was very fond of me. She told me many beautiful stories. I went to the village market with my father. I passed a happy time there. My father bought me sweetmeats. But those happy days are now gone. I was five years old. Then my birthday ceremony was held. I was very happy on that day. Many relatives came to our house. They took me to their laps (কোল) and kissed me. They called me ‘Zaman’. They brought for me many nice things and toys. I grow six years old. A Maulavi Shaheb taught me Arabic at home. Then I went to a primary school with my father. My teachers were very kind to me. The classmates also loved me. They welcomed me with love and interest. I took my first lesson. That was indeed a new experience for me. I am now far from my classmates but I shall never forget them. I grew ten years old. I saw an important event. It was my sister's marriage ceremony. Our house was decorated very well. Many guests were invited. They came to our house. I remember that we all bathed in small river. The summer days gave me great pleasure. This season brings with it many juicy fruits. We plucked (কুড়ানো) these fruits and ate them. We ran beside the corn fields. The whole day we roamed about the village. The village market was another place of great interest for me. I would go there with my father. Sometimes alone, I used to pass a happy time there. How happy I was in my childhood days! The golden childhood days peep into my mind. I feel that I was really happy in my childhood. I wish I could have my happy childhood days again.

question_text: A bus journey is really an excellent experience. Suppose you have such type of experience too. Now write a composition on 'A Journey by Bus' narrating when, why and where did you go by bus, what was your experience on the way, how much you liked it etc.
answer_text:
A Journey by Bus
A bus is a modern and motorized transport. A journey by bus is quick and comfortable. It is interesting, too. It is very common, easy and popular. Nowadays, every man can have the experience of a journey by bus. I had a journey by bus many times. I never forget the best of them. It was one spring. I was with my father. We were going to Rajshahi from Pabna. I was then a student of class V. My brother-in-law and my sister were working there in government offices. First we went to Pabna town by train and then got on a bus which was bound for Rajshahi. The road was not good. But the journey was interesting for me. It was my first journey by bus. The bus started late. It was over-crowded. We were sitting in the middle. My seat was beside a window. The bus could not run fast as the road was not good. There was jerking almost all the way. It was a local bus. So it stopped at many places. I could look outside and see the natural sceneries, houses and people in the fields. I could see rivers and canals and the green beauties of the villages. I felt very happy. I could not tolerate the gas or the engine. Though I was happy, I felt a bit sick. At one stage, I was vomiting. Suddenly the bus stopped. We were asked to get down because the bridge ahead was partly broken. However, when it was about dusk we crossed the bridge and again started for our destination. After about thirty minutes, the bus stopped at a bus stand. The conductor said that it was Rajshahi bus station. The passengers got down. I found my brother-in-law standing under a tree. He came forward to receive us. We got down and went to his residence. Thus the journey came to an end. The time is gone. But the memory is still fresh. We all wish interesting and safe bus journey.

question_text: Bangladesh is an over populated country. This large population is a threat to our national development. Now write a composition on 'Population Growth Hinders Development'. Describe some negative effects of over population, how does it increase our suffering, how does it hinder our socio-economic development etc.
answer_text:
Population Growth Hinders Development
Population growth and development are diametrically opposite (সম্পূর্ণরূপে বিপরীত) ideas. They cannot usually go hand in hand. So I am in favour of the opinion. The land area of our country is too small to support her large population. As a result it creates various problems in every sphere of our national life. Food problem, clothings problem, communication and educational problem, unemployment problem, environmental pollution, poverty etc are created by our extreme population growth. With all these problems, we can never have smooth developments. These problems will definitely obstruct development and progressive activities. Because of tremendous (ভয়ংকর) population growth, per capita income decreases, land per head decreases, land becomes fragmented, rate of saving declines, prices of things soar up, balance of trade becomes unfavourable, social values are degraded and so on. All these things also hinders economic growth and development. Ours is a developing country. We cannot expect to reach our desired goal without solving population problem. It is because population growth hinders development. The sooner we can solve the problem, the better.

question_text: Visiting any historical place refreshes our mind and increases the horizon of our knowledge. Now write a composition on your visit to any historical interest. You must highlight what is the main attraction of this place, whether there is any historical incident related to it, with whom did you go there etc.
answer_text:
My Visit to a Place of Historical Interest
A visit to a place of historical interest is really interesting and attracting. Dhaka is a place of historical interest. Last year I got the chance to visit Dhaka with my father. During the reign of Empreror Jahangir, Dhaka was set up by Islam Khan. Now it is the capital of Bangladesh. Many things of historical interest are still found here. I was spell-bound (মন্ত্রমুগ্ধ) when I saw the old relics of the city. At first I saw the fort of Lalbagh. I was astonished how it was built. I also saw Bara Katra, Choto Katra and tomb of Pari Bibi. These buildings still bear the witness of its past glory (অতীত গৌরব). Besides, I saw the famous cannon of Mir Jumla and the Ahsan Manjil of the Nawab of Dhaka. All these have great historical importance. On the way we saw the Dhakeswari temple (ঢাকেশ্বরী মন্দির) built by Ballal Sen. Gulshan, Baridhara, Dhanmondi, Uttara, the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, the latest extension of Dhaka and Tejgaon industrial area presented a different sight altogether. Moreover, I was charmed when I visited tall and magnificent (চমৎকার) buildings of Dhaka. The Medical College, the University, Salimullah Muslim Hall, the High Court, the Rajuk Building, the Bangladesh Bank, the Sangsad Bhaban, the Kamalapur Railway Station, the Stadium, the Baitul Mukarram Mosque etc. are worth mentioning (উল্লেখযোগ্য). Hotel Sheraton and Sonargaon are all designed according to modern taste. The Ramna Green, the Suhrawardy Uddan and the beautiful lawns attracted me very much. I also visited Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport and saw planes taking off and coming down. My first visit to Dhaka was of great interest. No doubt things I observed are very attractive. I left Dhaka with my father after four days with joy. My visit to Dhaka was memorable. It was really very pleasant. It has widened my knowledge and experience.
flag_note: মডেলে 'Empreror' ছাপা (Emperor-এর বদলে) — যেমন ছাপা তেমন রাখা হয়েছে।

question_text: A fair is a unique part of a village culture. It is a cosmopolitan festival for the rural people. Write a composition on "A village Fair I have recently visited/A visit to a village fair" narrating when and how it is arranged or held, what are its social, economic and cultural significances and why is it so important in the life of the villagers.
answer_text:
The Village Fair I Recently Visited/ A Visit to a Village Fair
A village fair is a part of our culture. In fact, a village fair bears an age-old tradition in the culture of Bangladesh. No other festival in rural Bangladesh is as flamboyant (উজ্জ্বল) as a village fair. Usually it is held on the first day of Bengali new year known as Pahela Baishakh. I had a great desire to visit a village fair. At last my desire had come true when I went to visit my grandfather and grandmother living at Laksmipur in the district of Madaripur. On that day I got up early and went to the fair with my cousins. It was held in the local bazar of the village. Being there I was astonished seeing the festive mood among all the people irrespective of age, sex, race and religion. It was an arrangement of selling and buying, gambling, jugglery and cultural functions. The stalls of the fair were fairly decorated and arranged according to the articles. Shopkeepers, artists and artisans set up their stalls with goods such as toys, sweet-meats, cosmetics, handicrafts, tapestries, bamboo-made goods and many attractive items. Mery-go-round, puppet show, magic show and circus were special attractions of the fair. A circus party brought tiger, elephants, monkeys, houses and bears to entertain the viewers. Children and boys and girls were highly amused. The enjoyed the fair to a great extent. They bought fancy goods llike, bangles, ribbons, bamboo flute, baloons etc. They also bought sweetmeats and earth made dolls. They rode merry-go-round and enjoyed puppet show. I myself also enjoyed all these things to a great extent. Beside the fair there were also gambling parties. Many took part in gambling many of whom seemed to be very sad as they lost money in gambling. The fair was very crowded and not so tidy. Nevertheless I enjoyed the fair to a great extent.
flag_note: মডেলে 'Mery-go-round', 'llike', 'baloons' ছাপা (merry-go-round, like, balloons-এর বদলে) — যেমন ছাপা তেমন রাখা হয়েছে।

question_text: Corruption is a great social problem in our country. It hinders our socio-economic development tremendously. Now write a composition titled as 'Corruption is a curse' mentioning the causes of corruption, in which sectors is it prevalent, how are people suffered by it and what should we do to abolish it.
answer_text:
Corruption is a Curse
Corruption is one of the social crimes that is considered to be an obstacle to progress. Hence, it is considered as a curse for a nation. Corruption means dishonest, illegal or immoral behaviour specially from someone who is in power. Corruption may originate from unsolved problems, unfinished works, vicious politics, weak administration and many other related or relevant things. The police department, education department, health department etc are the most corrupt sectors. Even the judicial department of the country which is an independent body is not free from corruption. The foreigners are always against the corruption of the country. It affects our people very much. The ultimate sufferings for corruptions go to the common people who are born to suffer and to be deprived of their legal rights, dues and so on. On the other hand, no corrupt person is hanged so far. The law machine is too slow to grind and punish the corrupt persons. To uproot this condition, we have to spread the light of true education.

question_text: Child labour is a curse. It is prevalent in many countries of the world. Suppose, you personally hate it. Now write a composition titled as 'Child labour shuold be banned' justifying your reasons for banning it.
answer_text:
Child Labour should be Banned
"The child is the father of the man" so children should be imparted noble values and virtues, so that they can grow up as good and responsible citizens of the country. By compelling them to work in this tender age, we are destroying their future prospect and also playing with the destiny of the country. It is indeed unfortunate that we find children being forced to work in order to earn their livelihood. Thus the hands that should be used for study or play are used for hard manual work. It is indeed a pity to see them toil and shoulder responsibilities which are too hard and heavy for them to do. Thus a childhood is wasted, which comes once in life of a man. Children are found working in agricultural sector, in the work of building construction, in the factories etc. They often risk their lives just to keep their body and soul together. So tragic is their condition that even in the childhood they become victim to physical and mental wreck (ধ্বংস). Their frail (ভঙ্গুর) body suffers from many ailments. The government should realise the gravity of the situation and ban child labour, making it an offence under law. But no ban can work unless we can ensure that the children are provided with food, shelter and education. This would not only bring back their childhood but also secure the future of the nation. Everybody should remember that the children are an asset to the nation.
flag_note: প্রশ্নে 'shuold' ছাপা (should-এর বদলে) — যেমন ছাপা তেমন রাখা হয়েছে।

question_text: Television is a common invention of modern science. It is used for both entertainment and gathering knowledge. Now write a composition on 'Television' mentioning the merits and demerits of it.
answer_text:
Television
The word 'tele' means 'distance' and 'vision' means 'sight'. So 'television' means 'sight from a distance'. It is a system which employs mechanical, photo-electrical and wireless processes for reproducing scenes, objects, talks, songs etc. at a long distance. It is a combination of radio and cinema. Television is powerful mass media like internet, newspaper etc. It broadcasts news and information on national and international aspects. It refreshes our mind and focuses on thought on the whole nation. It also highlights (তুলে ধরা) the on-going public concerns. So, as mass media, television has got much popularity. Television serves as a means for our recreation. After day's work, we sit before a television set and enjoy songs, dances, plays, movies, dramas, films etc. We feel that the artists have come to our drawing room in order to entertain us. As an instructor, television is of great use. It instructs people about their actions to solve the national problem like population, social crimes, present political issues, illiteracy, unemployment problem etc. It also draws attention of the concerned authorities by representing various reporting programmes on various issues of the country. Television has also bad sides. Sometimes naked films and violence are shown. So, our young generation can be spoilt by watching the bad scenes. They forget everything and concentrate their attention on it. Everything has its merits and demerits. But it is the most up-to-date means of communication. As a medium of mass communication, it has proved its superiority over newspaper, radio and other means.

question_text: Bangladesh is an over populated country. This large population is a threat to our national development. Now write a composition titled as 'Bangladesh is Overpopulated'. Describe some negative effects of over population, how does it increase our suffering, how does it hinder our socio-economic development etc.
answer_text:
Bangladesh is Overpopulated
Bangladesh is an independent country of a tiny land area. Its population is much bigger than its area. According to the recent statistics, 928 people live in per square kilometer. Therefore, the density of population is alarming, no doubt. In comparison to many other countries of the world, we are always observing almost the highest density of population in our country. All around is people and people. Thrusting in bus stop, railway station, launch terminal, market or shopping complex and gathering in engine driven vehicles are common picture of our country. The pedestrians (পথচারী) on footpath are stumbling due to gathering there even. The number of vehicles is going up day by day and the traffic jam is taking an alarming shape specially in city areas. Launches on the bosom of the rivers are sinking, wooden boats at rural ferry-ghat are tilting or capcising (ডুবে যাওয়া). Why? Here also the culprit is over population. I therefore, reasonably in favour of the opinion 'Bangladesh is over populated' understanding the pros and cons (খুঁটিনাটি) of the header. My firm stand for the header is for some other causes. According to census statistics, now death rate is lower than birth rate. Here I do not mean man should die unbridledly (লাগামহীনভাবে) I merely want to represent the mathematical fact. Of course, due to decline of child mortality rate the case is such and respecting this the contribution of physiology is undeniable, no doubt. Contrjbution of science and math is ever over our head. But we have to call spade a spade. Population is increasing, that's all. It is the subject matter that population is increasing, but matter is not that how and why. Seats in the educational institutions are limited, there is heavy gathering in the vehicles, miscreants in the land are rampant (বর্ধিষ্ণু), massive portion of us live below poverty line— all these prove the incapability of fulfiling our demand of daily necessaries and this incapability is gruesome (ভয়ংকর) result of over population. Bangladesh is not only an over populated country but also it is a land of population explosion in view of our capacity limitation and requirements. Want of proper family planning is functioning as the amplifier of over population.
flag_note: মডেলে 'capcising' ও 'Contrjbution' ছাপা (capsizing, Contribution-এর বদলে) — যেমন ছাপা তেমন রাখা হয়েছে।

question_text: Write a short composition in about 250 words on "Road accidents". Outlines : Daily occurrences—modern city life—death—condition—invention of automobiles —swifter movement of people—mechanized world—tragic effects on families—frequency in Bangladesh
answer_text:
Road accidents
Road accidents are daily occurrences in modern city life. Every year thousands of people die and many more are injured in road accidents. Before the invention of automobiles, people moved from one place to another slowly but safely. The real causes of road accidents lie with the people and not with the mechanized means of transport. In some cities, the roads are too narrow and inadequate. These can hardly cope with the ever-increasing volume of traffic. Besides, the traffic is not controlled and regulated properly. The pedestrians and the people who drive the automobiles very often violate traffic rules. As a result accidents take place. The situation becomes worse when the slow-moving rickshaws and carts tussle with cars, buses and trucks. To make the roads safe, steps shoud be taken to control the increasing volume of traffic. New roads should be constructed, and traffic signals should be set up at the key points. Through radio, television, newspaper and posters, people should be made aware of the traffic rules. Heavy penalty should be imposed on those who violate the rules. If the city administrations work well, the number of road accidents is sure to come down. Road accidents have become a great menace in our society. They have increased in number considerably in recent years. Many families have been ruined because of having road accidents. Immediate steps should be taken to stop this danger. Government agencies should work together with the public for a solution to this problem.
flag_note: মডেলে 'shoud' ছাপা (should-এর বদলে) — যেমন ছাপা তেমন রাখা হয়েছে।

question_text: Write a short composition in about 250 words on "Your experience of visiting a flood-affected area". Outlines : occurs in devastating raining season — relief camp — shelter in the camp and in other places — want of food water, medicine — so many problems — unlimited sufferings — a painful experience.
answer_text:
My experience of visiting a flood-affected area
Bangladesh is a land of rains and rivers. So flood is a regular calamity in the rainy season. It occurs almost every year in many parts of the country. In some years it becomes terribly devastating. A few years ago almost the whole of Bangladesh was inundated under flood water. It was then a matter of terrible experience. All the families of the locality were affected by flood. A relief camp was opened in the local high school. About two thousand villagers took shelter in it. So it was over crowded. There was an acute scarcity of drinking water. I found many children crying for food. Some women were weeping and wiping their tears with their skirts. They were all waiting for relief goods. Then I went round the village by a motor-driven boat. I found many families who had taken shelters on their house-roofs their domestic animals were also with them. There was only water and water around, I talked to them. Many of them shed tears while talking to me. I carried some dry food and rice with me. I distributed those among the needy people. They felt very happy. I was surprised to see how both domestic animals and the members of some families living in the same room. Their miseries knew no bounds. In the evening, I returned to my own house. The houses were not under flood water but the yard was submerged. I found my mother praying with tears in eyes. I can't still forget the horrible sight of that cataclysmic flood. May Allah save our people from such a flood.

question_text: Write a short composition in about 250 words on "International Mother Language Day". Outlines : a memorable day — 21 February — Pakistani rule — 21 February 1952 — in 2000 recognised by UNO — an International Language. How observed : on 21 February observed as a memorable day all over the world In Bangladesh, Probhat Ferry, walking bare footed — flowers and wreaths at the foot of Shahid Minar — special programmes by TV and Radio. Significance of the Day : Mother Language day, a spirit of liberation — world knows Bangla a sweet language — to try for the development of the language.
answer_text:
International Mother Language Day
In the history of mankind people around the world have many days to remember. International mother language day is one of the memorable days. Every independent nation observes the day in memory of the language martyrs and speaks in praise of the mother tongue. 21 February of every year is regarded as the international mother language day. On 21 February 1952, during the time of Pakistani rule some valiant sons of our country laid down their lives for our mother tongue, Bangla. Since then, the day had been observed as our Shaheed Day commemorating the sacrifice of the language martyrs. But since 2000, this day has been recognized by the UNO as the International Mother Language day. 21 February is now observed all over the world as a red letter day. In our country it is observed as a national mourning day. The National Flag is hoisted half mast to mark the day. People of all classes bring out a procession called "Probhat Ferry". Everybody in the procession, walks bare-footed and sings the sad song. — "Amar bhaer rakte rangano ............ Amiki bhulite pari." Flowers and wreaths are placed at the foot of the Shahid Minar to pay homage to the martyrs. Discussions, seminars and cultural shows are organized throughout the country. Our newspapers bring out special features. The TV & Radio put up special programmes highlighting the significance of the day. This day is of great significance. We have achieved Bangla as our mother tongue. The Language Movement gave us the spirit of liberation and we became independent in 1971. Today we are free and we have our own culture and heritage. This day has given us honour and fame. The world today recognizes that Bangla is an important language. We should try for the development of this language. We hope that in near future Bangla, like English, will be used as a medium of speech in different international forums.

question_text: Write a short composition in about 250 words on "The summer vacation you enjoyed". Outlines : a long rest — purpose — rest and recreation — campaign against illiteracy — helped parents in their daily activities — source of pleasure and knowledge.
answer_text:
The summer vacation I enjoyed
To me as to all students nothing is more welcome than a long vacation, such as a summer vacation. It provides the longest rest from the tedious routine of daily life. Indeed, it is the purpose of a long vacation to give rest and recreation to our body and mind. The students have a particular fascination for summer vacation. In the summer, mangoes and jack fruits ripen. So I spent the first few days of the last summer vacation by visiting some very near relations and indulging in eating mangoes, blackberries and jack fruits. In my maternal uncle's house my aunt selected the best mangoes for me. She found a great delight in feeding me with milk and mango-juice. But I am not so silly as to pass the vacation in a prolific way. I combined pleasure with profit and recreation with instruction. So after the round of visits I devoted myself to studies. I made a plan to revise all the lessons during the vacation. I made it successful. I read in the morning and evening, and worked out sums at noon regularly. My friends and I organised a campaign against illiteracy for two weeks. We set up night schools where we taught adults the three R's and gave them ideas on the comparative study of agriculture in different countries. Moreover, sometimes, I went to help my parents in their daily activities. Thus I turned the summer vacation to good account by pursuit of pleasure and knowledge. The vacation became profitable to me in many respects.

question_text: Write a short composition in about 250 words on "The sports day of your school".
answer_text:
The sports day of our school
The annual sports of our school came off yesterday. It was a very pleasant occasion. We spent almost the whole day in joy and pleasure. It is a memorable event to me. The field of the school was colourfully decorated with so many flags and festoons. The director General of Secondary and Higher Education was the chief guest. The Headmaster presided over the function. The chief guest was received with a guard of honour. The opening session began at 9 a.m. The National anthem was sung while the chief guest was hoisting the National Flag. The headmaster hoisted the sports flag and made a welcome adress. Then the chief guest inaugurated the function. A young athlete encircled the running tracks with a flaming torch in hand. Then the main sports events began. There were twenty events. About one hundred boys were participants. I was one of them. The cock fight, musical chair and dress as you like were the most interesting events. The games continued upto 3 p.m. with a break of 40 minutes. Then the turn of prize-giving came, many distinguished guests were present. The chief guest made a short speech. He encouraged us and spoke about the importance of games and sports in our life. He said that games and sports infuse in us the spirit of competition in all the spheres of life. They teach us sense of discipline and patience as well. Then the winner shook hands with him and received the prizes with greetings. The quality of the prizes were up-to satisfaction. They were expensive too. The champion prize was the most beautiful one. At last the president made his concluding speech and the function came to an end. We returned home in the evening.

question_text: Write a composition on "Our Cultural Heritage".
answer_text:
Our Cultural Heritage
Heritage means important qualities, customs and traditions that have been in a society for a long time. Our cultural heritage is very rich and affluent. Our culture is made up of our beliefs, ideas and ways of behaving. Language, music, ideas about what is good and bad, ways of working and playing and the tools and other objects made and used by people in our society— all these are parts of the culture of our society. Culture varies from individual to individual, group to group, country to country. From ancient time, people of this country use Bangla as their mother tongue. They are fond of folklore, palligeeti, bhatiali, marfati, murshidi, kabigan, jarigan, sharigan and jatra. They like to enjoy snake-charming and puppet-show. They are fond of boat-racing, bull fighting, cock fighting. Some local games are also popular with the people. They are ha-du-du, kabadi, bouchi, kanamachhi, gollachhut and so on. The popular dress for men is lungi and punjabi. Women wear saries and blouses. Children are fond of colourful dresses. We celebrate the Pahela Baishakh as a national festival. In keeping with age-old tradition, traders and shopkeepers open halkhata which means fresh account book and offer sweets to their customers and clients. Different socio-cultural organisations draw up elaborate programmes to celebrate the day. People of Bangladesh are very hospitable. They like to entertain everyone who visits their houses. But it is a matter of great regret that these modes and patterns of culture are being changed day by day. In fine, we must be careful to protect our long cultural heritage. We must be aware of the western assault to our culture.

question_text: We live in the age of science. Internet is one of the amenities of science. Now, write a composition on 'The Uses and Abuses of Internet'
answer_text:
The uses and abuses of internet
Internet has created a coruscation in the arena of recent information technology. It has brought about a revolutionary change in the mode of life. It not only influences an individual life in a country but also almost all the lives of the whole world. The worldwide computer network is called internet. Through internet we can communicate with any individual or institute very easily. Internet is a modern information technology. We can transfer file from one computer to another by using protocol. We can chat with others by using Internet Relay Chat. By using e-mail we can exchange information to others. By using internet we can have access to easy and quick information from all around the world. We can get service from internet by applying online or offline. To get service out of internet we are in need of computer, modem and telephone line, and thus we can make contact with the whole world in the twinkling of an eye. We can know global culture and custom through internet. In fact, it is of great use to us. Though internet is a modern mode of communication, it is not an unmixed blessing for all of us. Deception, watching pornography, gambling, blackmailing are being increased through internet. Especially the young generation is heavily affected by internet. Therefore, effective steps should be taken to prevent them from watching something obscene and odd on internet.

question_text: Narrate the story of Mary in your own words.
answer_text: Mary was a girl who lived beside the sea. One day her parents told her to bring the cattle home from the sands of Dee. Unfortunately, the weather was very adverse at that time. So, the sea tide came and took away Mary to the deep sea. Next day some local boatmen saw something in the net. They thought it was sea weed, or salmon fish. But finally they found that it was the tress of golden hair of a maiden. Thus Mary faced a tragic death being drowned in the sea. Still the boatmen hear Mary calling the cattle home across the sands of Dee.

question_text: Why is graffiti important for marginalized community?
answer_text: Graffiti gives a voice to people who are ignored or treated unfairly. It keeps their struggles visible to others. That's why graffiti is important for marginalized people.

question_text: How does graffiti promote solidarity?
answer_text: Graffiti brings people together by sharing common goals or struggles. It shows unity through powerful symbols and words. Thus graffiti promotes solidarity.

question_text: What makes graffiti a powerful tool for dissent?
answer_text: Graffiti spreads ideas that challenge unfair systems. It is a powerful tool for dissent because it is quick, bold, and unstoppable.

question_text: Why is graffiti considered resilient?
answer_text: Graffiti is resilient because it survives efforts to erase it. It keeps the memories of struggles alive for a long time.

question_text: What does "immediacy" mean in graffiti?
answer_text: Immediacy means creating graffiti quickly to spread the message fast. It is necessary to avoid danger or interruptions.
